cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Elizabeth Arden, New York, NY, 1939; Patricia Graham Young, New York, NY, by 1986; Estate of Patricia Graham Young, 1990; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 6025, lot no. 230, 24 May 1990; Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, and Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, 1990; (Thea Westreich Art Advisory Services, Inc., New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to Elizabeth Arden." Backing inscription dates 1939. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1938. Dated 1938 on basis of inclusion in 1939 New York (An American Place) exhibition and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: A White Camellia

description: Layers of soft, white camellia petals surround a yellowish center. Light and dark green leaves fill the negative space surrounding the flower.
